files.reason: This change restores the published sign-in procedure when a tab outlives a deployment. The page reloads before asking the API to authenticate. The reviewed FR/HE/EN first-login and internal Backoffice guides already describe signing in again after a session update and completing the second factor. Restaurant access, roles, recovery, and existing authenticated sessions keep their documented behavior.
